conditions: Make the disclosure understandable before people provide the data.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Design principles experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるDesign principlesの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

manual: Does the design satisfy “When collecting data, disclose what you collect and how you use it.” in the documented Design principles context?

anti_patterns: Ignoring this guidance in a context where the source section applies.
positive_examples: A design review records how the implementation satisfies this rule and any source-scoped exception.

source.evidence_paraphrase: When collecting data, disclose what you collect and how you use it.

title: Minimize data collection

statement.en: Collect only the data the product needs to function.
statement.ja: productのfunctionに必要なdataだけを収集する。

conditions: Do not expand collection beyond functional need.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Design principles experience on the scoped Apple platforms.

title: Protect data from misuse and harm

statement.en: Protect data against foreseeable misuse, harm, abuse, and unintended consequences.
statement.ja: foreseeableなmisuse、harm、abuse、unintended consequenceからdataを保護する。

conditions: Evaluate both intentional abuse and unintended downstream effects.
